accept.askBody: There is nothing to send. Ask them the way you would ask anybody — the app carries no request and will not chase them. If they agree, this will say the membership is settled.
accept.askLink: Or ask them to close it first
accept.askTitle: Ask them to close it first
accept.canInvite: You would be able to add and remove people.
accept.cannotInvite: You would not be able to add or remove anyone.
accept.deadBody: An invitation works once. Ask whoever sent it for another one.
accept.decliningNote: Declining creates nothing, and they are not told who declined.
accept.history: If you join, you will be able to read everything already said here — including anything said before you arrived.
accept.invalid: This is not an invitation we can read
accept.invitesYouUnattributed: invites you to a strand. The invitation does not say who sent it — trust it as far as you trust them.
accept.joining: Joining — reaching them and copying the conversation so far. This can take a minute or two.
accept.spent: This invitation has already been used

chat.editing: Editing — this replaces what you said
chat.empty: Say something — it is just the two of you until anyone else is invited.
chat.emptyAlone: You can write before anyone joins. Whoever takes up an invitation will be able to read it.
chat.micTitle: Voice messages are not built yet

errors.unreachable: There is nowhere for them to answer yet.
errors.not-attached: This conversation is not on this device.

unavailable.default: Could not get through just now. Try again in a moment.
unavailable.owner-not-ready: This device is still setting up its network. Try again in a moment.

errors.not-a-member: This device could not be added as a member of the conversation.
errors.join-inviter-unreachable: Could not reach the person who invited you. Their app may be closed or offline — try again when they are back.
errors.invitation-spent: This invitation has already been used or has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invitation-not-ready: The invitation is not ready on their side yet. Try again in a moment.
errors.join-refused: The person who invited you did not let this join go through.
errors.join-host-busy: Their side could not finish this join just now. Try again in a moment.
errors.join-host-outdated: This conversation was made with an older version and cannot take new members. Ask for a new invitation.
errors.join-incomplete: You were let in, but this device could not finish setting up the conversation. Ask for a new invitation.
errors.invitation-unusable: This invitation cannot be used. Ask for a new one.

invalid-node-code.default: This is not a usable node code.
invalid-node-code.not-node-code: This is not a node code.
invalid-node-code.newer-version: This code comes from a newer version of the node software. Update the app to use it.
invalid-node-code.damaged: This code is incomplete or damaged.

node-unreachable.default: Could not reach that machine. Check that it is running and try again.
node-unreachable.home-network: Could not reach that machine. It can only be reached on its own network: join that Wi-Fi and try again.
node-unreachable.anywhere: Could not reach that machine. Check that it is running and try again.

claim-refused.claim-rate-limited: The machine is refusing for now after too many tries. Wait a little and try again.

claim-failed.default: Adding the machine did not finish. Trying again is safe.
claim-failed.busy: A machine is already being added.

invite.anyoneAndRights: Anyone who finds this link can join and then add or remove anyone, including you. It cannot be recalled.
invite.canInviteOff: They cannot add or remove anyone
invite.canInviteOffShort: they cannot add or remove anyone
invite.canInviteOn: They can add and remove people
invite.canInviteOnShort: they can add and remove people
invite.forAnyoneBody: Works for everyone who has it, until it runs out. It cannot be recalled.
invite.forOneBody: Spent once used, so a lost copy is useless to anyone else.
invite.forgetNote: Taking it off this list does not cancel it: whoever holds it can still use it until it runs out.
invite.historyWarning: Whoever takes this up will be able to read everything already said here, including what was said before they arrived.
invite.nothingYet: The strand is ready. Nobody else is in it until somebody accepts.
invite.postBody: Everyone in this strand will be able to use it. That hands every member a one-off ability to bring somebody in. If you can reach the person another way, do that instead.
invite.privateBody: Only people you invite can be in it.
invite.publicBody: Anyone with the link can join, and nobody can be removed.
invite.relayPendingBody: This usually takes a few seconds. You can make the invitation as soon as it is connected.
invite.relaySlow: This is taking longer than it should. The relay may be down, or this network may block it — some work, school and public Wi-Fi do. Try another network, or choose another relay.
invite.rightsBody: Passing this on gives them the same reach you have — including over you.
invite.shareBody: You are invited to talk privately on Sereus Chat. Open this link on your phone:
invite.shareBodyNamed: {{name}} invites you to talk privately on Sereus Chat. Open this link on your phone:
invite.termsKept: Kept for when you come back: {{kind}}, {{rights}}.
invite.unreachableSwitch: You can start with one and change later.
invite.wayBorrowBody: The quick way: free, nothing to set up. Whoever runs it can see that you talk to someone, when, and roughly how much — never what you say. Opens the list on sereus.org; you confirm your pick here.
invite.wayOwnBody: The private way: nobody else sees who you talk to. Needs a machine that stays on. Opens the instructions on sereus.org.

media.empty: Photos, files and voice messages will collect here.

profile.nameRequired: A name is needed so people recognise you.
profile.noAccount: No account is being created. There is no password and nothing to sign in to.
profile.sharedNote: Your name and picture go to the people in your strands. In a strand that can still grow, people you have not met may come to see them.

relay.badBody: A relay address has to name the exact machine it belongs to. This one does not, so there would be no way to tell whether you had reached the right one.
relay.badTitle: This is not a relay we can read
relay.claimed: The name this link gives. Nothing proves it.
relay.cost: Whoever runs it will be able to see that you are talking to someone, when, and roughly how much — never what you say.
relay.costNote: You are choosing this particular person to know that much. You can change it later.
relay.lede: A relay passes traffic along so people can reach you. You are not signing up for anything, and you can stop using it whenever you like.
relay.title: Use this relay?

search.partial: {{n}} strands could not be reached, so this is not everything.

settings.ceilingNote: The limit is yours to set. Nothing is imposed, and nothing is deleted on your behalf.
settings.languageNote: Only the app's own words change. Messages are never translated.
settings.overCeiling: You are at the limit you set. Nothing has been deleted — raise the limit, trim what you are holding, or add a machine.
settings.overrides: {{n}} strands have their own setting, which this does not change.
settings.title: Settings

relay.reserved: Working — people can reach you through this.
relay.notWorking: Not working yet. Still trying — you are not reachable until it does.

reach.home-network: Can only be reached on its own network.

public.label: Open to anyone
public.sentence: Anyone with the link can join. Nobody can be removed.

settled.label: Settled
settled.sentence: Nobody can be added or removed. This is who it will always be.

canChange.label: Can still change
canChange.sentence: Only invited people are here. {{who}} can add or remove anyone{{you}}.

strand.archiveHint: Hide it from your list; nothing changes for anyone else
strand.forgetBody: Permanent. What identifies you here is discarded along with everything you hold. If you are ever invited back you arrive as a stranger, and what you said before stays under who you used to be.
strand.hideHint: Out of your list until you look for it; nothing changes for anyone else
strand.leaveBody: It carries on without you and nothing more reaches you. You keep what identifies you here, so if you are invited back you return as yourself.
strand.managing: Because you can add and remove people
strand.noDelete: A strand cannot be deleted. Leaving is what you can do; it carries on for everyone else.
strand.othersInvitations: Invitations other members have out are not shown: an invitation is known only to whoever made it.
strand.removeBody: Nothing further reaches them. It does not undo anything they have already read.
strand.resignExposed: This cannot be undone. Afterwards you will not be able to remove anyone — and the others who still can will be able to remove you.
strand.resignFinal: This cannot be undone. Nobody will be able to add or remove anyone, ever. This is who the strand will always be.
strand.resignTitle: Give up adding and removing people?

strands.empty: A strand is a conversation you and somebody else agree to. Until you have one, nobody can reach you — and you can reach nobody.
strands.hideHint: Out of your list until you look for it; nothing changes for anyone else
strands.muteHint: Stays in your list; you are just not told about it
strands.muteSoftNow: Currently quiet unless somebody names you
strands.openDetailsHint: Members, what is shared, and leaving
strands.searchCost: Looks inside every strand, and wakes the ones that are asleep

viewer.unreachable: This is not reachable right now. Nothing has been lost — no machine holding it can be reached from here at the moment.
